summary:
**BOO-YAH! Week 11 Was Cooler Than the Other Side of the Pillow!**

Listen up, fantasy faithful—Week 11 just served up more drama than a season finale, and cosmohouck came through dropping 149.64 points like he was Kendrick dropping bars at the Super Bowl! My man had Tetairoa McMillan catching passes for 29.0 and Bijan Robinson running for 28.3, straight up taking Tishathefish to school—he must be the bus driver because that 60.30-point beatdown was a full-on field trip! Meanwhile, Tishathefish left Isaac Guerendo's goose egg in the lineup and benched 20.8 points worth of talent. That's like showing up to the potluck with an empty casserole dish, homie!

But let's talk about the rivalry brewing hotter than fish grease between mjgrana and drobs! These two squads have been circling each other like heavyweight contenders, and mjgrana just landed the knockout punch with a 38.64-point victory behind Christian McCaffrey's monster 32.6-point performance and George Pickens' 24.9-point explosion. CMC was smoother than butter on a bald head out there! Meanwhile, drobs watched David Montgomery stumble to 4.2 points and RJ Harvey limp to 6.5—that's colder than yesterday's oatmeal, baby! Even with Kenneth Walker's solid 18.6 and Jameson Williams' 17.7, drobs couldn't keep pace with the #2-ranked mjgrana, who's trending up faster than Bitcoin in 2021!

Now check this out—PrinceofPizza is serving up three consecutive weeks of hot streak magic, riding that 128.4 recent average like he's got the cheat codes! Bryce Young dropped 31.8 points at quarterback, and suddenly PrinceofPizza looks like he ordered extra toppings on his fantasy squad. But hold up—my man left Quentin Johnston's zero-burger in the lineup AND benched 23.4 points. That's like leaving money on the table at the casino, playa! As cool as the other side of the pillow that victory was, it could've been even sweeter.

Speaking of cold streaks, somebody check on tr4sh because this cat's been struggling for SIX WEEKS like he's stuck in quicksand! Even with Tyrone Tracy's 15.9 and Marcus Mariota's 15.4, tr4sh couldn't escape the skid against PrinceofPizza's red-hot squad. And don't even get me started on powerperson, who put up a league-low 43.36 points—that's not just cold, that's Antarctic! Khalil Shakir with 0.2 points? Man, that's like ordering a pizza and getting just the box! Josh Allen showed out with 42.7 points for Langland, but when you're starting Dont'e Thornton and Ray Davis for matching zeroes, you're gonna have a bad time. **BOO-YAH!**
